decisions.source: RAPTOR style defended 2P value and 3PA contest volume

definitions.how_it_works: Five-year-target SPM prior with stabilized feature additions, updated by one season of possession RAPM.
Original five-year-target SPM prior, updated by one season of possession RAPM.
definitions.interpretation: Retrospective impact estimate; frozen comparison baseline.

definitions.how_it_works: Zero-prior ridge regression on possession outcomes with separate offensive and defensive player coefficients.
definitions.interpretation: Noisy one-season lineup-adjusted reference, not a forecast.

definitions.how_it_works: Box, play-by-play, and tracking features predict annual zero-prior RAPM without using lineup outcomes as inputs.
Leave-one-season-out ridge on 15 traditional per-100 box rates trained against annual RAPM.
definitions.interpretation: Transparent box-only baseline; not full PIPM.

definitions.how_it_works: Published box-score coefficients vary by estimated position and offensive role, then receive a team-efficiency adjustment.
Statistical prior plus regularized adjusted plus-minus; defense is converted to positive-good here.
definitions.interpretation: Prior-informed impact comparator, not independent of RAPM.

definitions.how_it_works: Role-stabilized BoxPIPM prior combined with luck-adjusted RAPM.
definitions.interpretation: Retrospective impact estimate from BBall Index.

definitions.how_it_works: Current-season statistical prior combined with time-decayed multi-year RAPM and small shooting-luck adjustments.
Stat-specific estimated skills feed an SPM prior, which is combined with RAPM.
definitions.interpretation: Supplied all-season snapshot; historical values may reflect the current model rather than archived season-end vintages.

caveats: The next-season team-win benchmark uses observed next-season minutes and is therefore an oracle-minutes retrodiction, not a preseason forecast.
Metric agreement is not evidence that either metric is correct.
EPM values come from the supplied all-season snapshot rather than archived model vintages captured at each historical season end.
BoxPIPM-style is a transparent box-score-only baseline, not a full PIPM reproduction.
